title: Evidence Lab plugin metadata
description: Registry metadata kept outside plugin.json so the native manifest stays compatible with Claude Code. Carries provenance, review trail and distribution class.

status.description: reference = template only, never installed for real work. draft = proposed, not reviewed. production = passed review and at least one real run.

category.description: Marketplace category. Keep the list short; add a value only when two plugins need it.

risk_level.description: team_safe = shareable with the whole team. internal_only = touches internal infrastructure, stays out of exports.

reviewer.description: Who signs off changes. Must differ from owner for production status.

origin.description: Where the knowledge came from: whose practice, which instance, which engagement.

evidence.description: Links or references backing the procedure. A skill without evidence is somebody's guess.

deterministic_parts.description: Scripts that produce the repeatable artefact. The model reasons; these files make the output reproducible.

portable_to.description: Runtimes the skills were checked against during the current Claude Code and Codex product phase.
